maddeler.e:
افتضخن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَخْنَ (iftaḍaḵna) /if.ta.dˤax.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اُفْتُضِخْنَ (uftuḍiḵna) /uf.tu.dˤix.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اِفْتَضِخْنَ (iftaḍiḵna) /if.ta.dˤix.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
